services.name: Private Sandbar & Beach Landing Cruise
services.desc: This is a 2.5 hour cruise for your group of up to 18 passengers. While traveling the waterways to the sandbar you will have the opportunity to see dolphins, manatees, pelicans, ospreys, bald eagles and so much more. Once we arrive at the sandbar your fun in the sun continues. Swimming, snorkeling, shelling, shark teeth hunting or floating, whatever you desire. All you need to bring is a cooler with refreshments, snacks or food, snorkeling equipment, floats water shoes and sunscreen. Alcohol beverages OK
